name: normalize-output
info:
Normalizes telemetry key-value pairs into ThingsBoard native flat JSON format.

Input:
- msg.payload: object with telemetry key-value pairs
- msg.timestamp: (optional) epoch_ms timestamp
- msg.output_topic: (optional) target MQTT topic

Output:
- msg.payload: {"ts": <epoch_ms>, "values": {key: val, ...}}
- msg.topic: set to msg.output_topic if provided

name: normalize-to-thingsboard

label: protocol-normalization
info:
Protocol Normalization Flow (FR2/FR3)

Normalizes sensor data from diverse protocols into ThingsBoard native flat JSON.

Input topics: nexus/raw/{protocol}/{zone_id}/{device_id}
Output topic: nexus/{zone_id}/{device_id}/telemetry
Output format: {"ts": <epoch_ms>, "values": {"key": value}}

Supported protocols (MVP):
- Modbus TCP (direct polling via modbus-read node)
- Modbus RTU (direct polling via serial/modbus-read node)
- OPC-UA (subscribe via OpcUa-Client node)
- BACnet (polling via bacnet-read node)
- Generic MQTT (LoRaWAN, Zigbee, Z-Wave, LwM2M, SNMP bridge outputs via raw topic)

Direct polling nodes are disabled by default (require physical hardware).
Bridge-based protocols publish to nexus/raw/{protocol}/{zone_id}/{device_id}.
